statement:
The recorded value shows an unpaid invoice for USD 148,300, but the payment history indicates it was already paid in full on 3 September.

I will **hold** this invoice to prevent a duplicate payment.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the record contradicts itself — "shows an unpaid invoice... but the payment history indicates it was already paid in full" — and holds payment to prevent duplicate.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
